Usage:  circleci run approve <run-number-or-id> [flags]

Flags:
  -f, --force            skip confirmation prompt
  -h, --help             help for approve
      --job string       name or UUID of the approval job to approve
      --jq string        Process values from the response using jq syntax
      --json             Output as JSON
      --project string   Project slug (e.g. gh/org/repo); used when approving by number
